content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal provide a familiar interface and integrated payment processing, but they come with geographical limitations. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, excluding many regions where digital creators reside. Meanwhile, alternatives like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer similar services but can also impose restrictions based on country. Sovereign commerce infrastructure from COREMERCH, however, delivers a different value proposition. By utilizing tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-10|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]], creators can build and own their digital storefronts without the dependency on conventional payment processors. This setup allows for full control over products, payments, and customer data.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal's policies effectively exclude many countries, forcing creators to either abandon their efforts or seek unreliable workarounds. PayPal’s account suspensions can freeze funds for up to 180 days, leaving creators in financial limbo without recourse. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure through COREMERCH does not discriminate based on geography. By leveraging technologies that function independently of these platforms, creators can transact freely using cryptocurrencies. This eliminates the issues of geographic exclusion and provides a robust solution for creators worldwide, ensuring they can monetize their work without restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed and fees, traditional platforms often fall short for creators in restricted regions. Stripe may tout instant payment processing, but if you can’t use it, that speed means nothing. PayPal's fees can also accumulate, especially with currency conversions. COREMERCH, on the other hand, uses NOWPayments to facilitate transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies with just a 0.5% fee. Payments are confirmed on-chain almost instantly, allowing for seamless transactions without the financial burdens imposed by conventional platforms. This means more of your sales revenue stays with you, enhancing your earning potential.
You own everything after deployment — no strings attached.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical aspect that distinguishes COREMERCH from traditional platforms. With Stripe and PayPal, you rely on their infrastructure, meaning they control the payment flow and even access to your funds. If your account gets suspended, your business can suffer. COREMERCH ensures that once your sovereign commerce stack is deployed, you maintain full ownership of everything—from your products to customer data. Automation is built in, allowing for instant product delivery and payment confirmation without ongoing reliance on third-party services. This level of control and sovereignty is a game-changer for creators looking to build sustainable businesses.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and the scale of your digital products. If you are just starting, the Sovereign Starter Stack offers a quick and effective solution at a low cost, enabling you to sell three products. For those needing more robust capabilities, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a comprehensive solution with five products and additional features. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) encompasses all blueprints and templates necessary for scaling your digital commerce operations, ensuring you have everything needed to succeed. Assess your requirements and choose the architecture that aligns with your goals.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Payments are instant, and fees are minimal with NOWPayments.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
